regions.full_page: Strepticoptic Infection of Lungs & Hopeless Heart - leakage. Hon. Judge Patrick Joseph Mary Holly, 59, now in St. Mary's Hospital took sick during trip in the East with wife & sons and arrived in Detroit - St. Mary's Hospital July 30 was enrolled 2nd time Aug 20th when all doctors and nurses and family seemed hopless. To- day Sept. 3 condition reported not worse except gradual weakness increasing; we enroll him again. Please God, waiting for good report. - His wife and children promissing frequent & daily com. . ... Same day 9 p.m. Mrs. Holly phones "improvement". Sept. 4 8.45 p.m. poison reported as leaving his blood, doctor have some hope again - Sept. 5th perspiring freely - a good sign if strength keeps up. Sept. 6 ..... Very weak - no apetite, less hopeful. 7th Some improvement again. Sept. 8 B. V.M. Nat: - Very, Very much improved. 9th Mrs. Holly reports personly - Improvement still .. 12th Bad turn. 14th Recd. USA Papal Ben. by cable. . . . Oct. 3rd Leaves Hospital hopeful .... happy!
